Apply.call_visit: Call them, or visit during opening hours.
Apply.phone: Call the number below. Ask for an interpreter in your language.
Apply.online_city: Apply online, or at any City of Ottawa recreation centre.
Apply.registry: Register online with the City of Ottawa Child Care Registry, or call 3-1-1.
Apply.doctor: Ask your doctor or health provider to apply with you.
Apply.lhin: Call 310-2222 and ask for a home care assessment.
Apply.register_ottawa: Register online at registerottawa.ca, or call the number below.
Apply.school: Ask at your child's school, or call OCISO.
Apply.app: Download the ConnectHear app on your phone.
Apply.ow_odsp: Ask your Ontario Works or ODSP worker, or visit OC Transpo Customer Service.
Apply.odsp: Ask for an application at the ODSP office. Your doctor fills in the medical forms.
